svg.text: Systems Thinking Studio — full setup, cadence, ownership, and durable gap closure
North star: Every material systems intervention is observable, causal, bounded, falsifiable, approved where required, and recoverable. | authority: STAGED_NOT_PROMOTED
02 Frame boundary, stocks, flows, and delays

09 Learn and route the next information gap
DO: sets priorities, approves typed high-impact actions, accepts/rejects strategic bets
NOT: serve as a hidden scheduler or evidence writer
DO: routes missions, selects bounded agents/tools, owns orchestration
jake-pai — Execution body and systems observer
DO: runs systems scans, intervention packets, evidence capture, and staged learning
NOT: approve external action, mutate frozen doctrine, or terminate its own mission
NOT: skip VERIFY or invent citations
DO: classifies clear/complicated/complex/chaotic/disorder, records confidence and the matching response mode before leverage
NOT: select leverage, authorize intervention, or silently turn disorder into a plan
DO: produce the named phase artifact and hand off only on gate green
NOT: cross phase ownership without an explicit packet
DO: collect captions/papers/HN evidence and source hashes on the 36GB node
NOT: promote doctrine or write canonical policy
DO: owns schedules, concurrency, and run history
NOT: become a second business scheduler
DO: records durable observations and waits
DO: runs deterministic verification, planted failures, and ProofPacket sealing
NOT: author the intervention it seals
Control-plane scan: source freshness, Prefect queue age, model availability, last-success/failure receipts
Gate: UNKNOWN/DEGRADED surfaces instead of healthy-by-default
Exactly ten evidence-ranked lessons and explicit information gaps
Gate: 10 source URLs + hashes or RED
Gate: approval scope/expiry recorded for high-impact actions
Gate: context/confidence/response mode, archetype, counterfactual, WIP, owner, and falsifier present
Gate: WIP and queue-age within budget or new work deferred
Shadow/plant-failure exercise for the active control boundary
Gate: planted RED then restored GREEN
Gate: evidence packet, owner, and next information task persisted
freshness/SLO review; stale scheduled work terminalized; source gaps ranked
system boundary maps, stocks/flows, delays, archetype hypotheses
one intervention/shadow packet per active constraint; WIP and approval boundaries
situation coverage, planted failures, restore drills, degraded-state reviews
human decision review, ProofPackets, mechanism promotion candidates, next-week gaps
bounded corpus backfill and second-source-class repair
canonical verifier, backup/restore rehearsal, owner handoff review
5. Thirty durable setups — status, owner, and proof gate
Gap: Raw corpus stopped at partial 3.428GB cutoff
Durable: Resume exact 5GB campaign from SQLite checkpoint
Proof: campaign gate: bytes>=5GB plus source/topic floors
Gap: Multi-agent coordination lacks second source class
Gap: Workflow scheduler authority lacks second source class
Gap: Knowledge organizational learning lacks second source class
Durable: Learning-loop primary + practitioner source pack
Gap: Complex adaptive systems lacks second source class
Gap: Incident learning lacks second source class
Durable: SRE postmortem + resilience source pack
Gap: Decision calibration lacks second source class
Durable: Forecast calibration primary + applied source pack
Gap: Cynefin framework is absent from Studio spine
Durable: Source-gated Cynefin card with domain-frame decision rules
Proof: FRAME chooses/defers complexity mode with evidence
Gap: Meadows leverage hierarchy is thin
Gap: Senge archetype evidence is thin

Proof: DIAGNOSE requires archetype evidence row

Proof: lease conflict yields DEGRADED with fallback model receipt
Gap: Model schema key typo required one deterministic repair

Proof: bad key RED; exact-hash repair receipt GREEN
Gap: Prefect stale auto-schedule backlog starves runner slots

Proof: live cleanup terminalizes only overdue auto runs; manual/future runs remain
Gap: Prefect API can return Service Unavailable during backlog pressure
Durable: API SLO, bounded retry, backlog count alert, direct run rescue receipt
Proof: SLO breach emits DEGRADED + queue evidence
Gap: Cancelled SSH worker once orphaned remote child
Proof: cancel plant leaves zero remote workers
Gap: Campaign writer lock must prevent duplicate raw writers
Proof: second writer RED, released lock GREEN
Gap: Approval routing is convention, not typed boundary map
Proof: wrong or expired approver RED before action
Gap: Intervention packets lack explicit rival explanation
Gap: Human incentives and override routes are incompletely modeled
Gap: Situation coverage is not standard in Studio verification
Gap: Shadow-mode divergence gate is not standard

Proof: one query reconstructs causal chain

Durable: LAN restoration + mount SLO + durable spool
Proof: mount loss surfaces DEGRADED and spool restore passes

Gap: Generated artifact trees pollute source verification
Proof: ignored runtime PEM does not false-fail; planted source PEM RED

Proof: expired mechanism cannot be used without revalidation
